polity.canonical_name_en: Kingdom of Jiujiang under Ying Bu

activity.notes: Xiang Yu enfeoffed Ying Bu as King of Jiujiang in 206 BCE. Liu Bang later established him as King of Huainan in Han year 4 (203 BCE), so this Activity records the earlier Jiujiang kingship separately from his later Huainan kingship.

sources.title: 史記 卷091 黥布列傳
sources.citation_text: The Shiji records Xiang Yu enfeoffing Bu as King of Jiujiang and later records Liu Bang establishing him as King of Huainan in Han year 4.
